skill.name: freshdesk-automation
skill.description: Automate Freshdesk ticket, contact, company, note, and reply workflows through Rube MCP. The skill emphasizes current tool schemas and Freshdesk parameter requirements.
skill.summary: Guide Freshdesk support workflows through Rube MCP with schema-aware ticket, contact, and company operations.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The external command alerts are Markdown code spans, the network alert is a documented MCP setup URL, and the reconnaissance alerts describe Freshdesk workflow terms.

remediation.suggestion: Explain that Rube MCP processes Freshdesk tool requests and may receive ticket, contact, and company data during use.
Add an explicit confirmation step before creating tickets, updating records, sending replies, importing contacts, or editing conversations.

remediation.issue: HTML content in tickets and replies
remediation.suggestion: Advise users to review generated HTML before sending customer-facing messages or ticket descriptions.

3. `FRESHDESK_CREATE_TICKET` - Create a new ticket with subject, description, requester info [Requir

5. `FRESHDESK_VIEW_TICKET` - Retrieve full ticket details by ID [Optional]

- `requester_id`: User ID of requester (alternative to email)
- `responder_id`: Agent ID to assign the ticket to
- `group_id`: Group to assign the ticket to

- If `phone` is provided without `email`, then `name` becomes mandatory

4. `FRESHDESK_LIST_ALL_TICKET_CONVERSATIONS` - View all messages and notes on a ticket [Optional]

- `user_id`: Agent ID to reply on behalf of

- `notify_emails`: Only accepts agent email addresses, not external contacts

content.value_statement: Support teams lose time switching between ticket, contact, and company tasks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Freshdesk actions using Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Searches Rube MCP for current Freshdesk tool schemas before running workflows.
Creates, updates, views, lists, and searches Freshdesk tickets with required parameter guidance.
Adds public replies, private notes, and conversation updates to Freshdesk tickets.
Searches and manages Freshdesk contacts, companies, and related custom fields.
Documents Freshdesk status, priority, source, pagination, and query syntax requirements.
Calls out common parameter mistakes for attachments, custom fields, IDs, and search queries.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Freshdesk connection before any workflow can run.
Freshdesk permissions, plan limits, and account configuration control which actions succeed.
The skill does not store Freshdesk credentials or replace Freshdesk access controls.
Bulk imports and broad searches can hit Freshdesk rate limits or result limits.

use_cases.title: Create Support Tickets
use_cases.description: Capture requester details, choose ticket fields, and create new Freshdesk tickets with correct status and priority values.

use_cases.title: Resolve Ticket Backlogs
use_cases.description: Search open or urgent tickets, inspect details, add notes, and send replies with consistent Freshdesk parameters.

use_cases.title: Maintain Customer Records
use_cases.description: Find contacts and companies, update company fields, and align records with Freshdesk query and pagination rules.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Ticket
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner ticket creation with one requester.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Freshdesk ticket for customer email [email]. Use subject [subject], description [description], priority [priority], and portal source.

prompt_templates.title: Search Priority Tickets
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate ticket triage by status and priority.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Freshdesk for open high-priority tickets created since [date]. Show ticket IDs, requester details, status, and next action.

prompt_templates.title: Reply and Add a Private Note
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced customer communication with internal tracking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Freshdesk ticket [ticket_id], draft a customer reply, then add a private note summarizing the reason and follow-up owner.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Company Records
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Freshdesk contacts for company domain [domain], match the company record, and identify missing fields before any updates.

output_examples.input: Create a ticket for ada@example.com about a failed invoice download.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the requester, confirms required fields, and creates a Freshdesk ticket with a clear subject and description.

output_examples.input: Find urgent open tickets from this week and summarize them.
output_examples.output: The assistant searches Freshdesk, returns a concise ticket list, and highlights requester, status, priority, and recommended next step.

output_examples.input: Add an internal note to ticket 4832 after checking its conversation history.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the ticket conversation, drafts a private note, and asks for confirmation before saving it.

best_practices: Run the Rube tool search first so prompts use current Freshdesk schemas.
Resolve emails, names, and companies to Freshdesk IDs before making updates.
Confirm customer-facing replies and record changes before sending them.
anti_patterns: Do not send public replies without reviewing the generated message.
Do not assume status, priority, source, or custom field values are strings.
Do not use broad list-all operations when filtered Freshdesk searches are available.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Freshdesk API key?
faq.answer: It requires an active Freshdesk connection through Rube MCP. Freshdesk credentials are handled by that connection flow.

faq.question: Can it create and update tickets?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents ticket creation, update, view, list, and search workflows with Freshdesk parameter guidance.

faq.question: Can it send replies to customers?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Freshdesk reply workflows, and users should review customer-facing messages before sending.

faq.question: Can it manage contacts and companies?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers contact search, contact listing, company search, company creation, company updates, and company fields.

faq.question: Does it work without Rube MCP?
faq.answer: No. The skill depends on Rube MCP and its Freshdesk toolkit for tool discovery and actions.

faq.question: Does it bypass Freshdesk permissions?
faq.answer: No. Freshdesk account permissions and the connected user role still control available operations.
